definitions.explanation: a fee paid regularly to belong to an organization or club
money collected from participants to cover the costs of an event like a party or dinner

examples.japanese: ⟦{年会費|ねんかいひ}→年会費：06414_nenkaihi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: The annual membership fee is 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {会費|かいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会費|かいひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧4,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: The cost for the drinking party is 4,000 yen per person.

examples.japanese: {会費制|かいひせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Fee-based wedding receptions are becoming more common.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, organization) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense, fee)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年会費|ねんかいひ}→年会費：06414_nenkaihi⟧ - annual fee
- ⟦{月会費|げっかいひ}→月会費：18876_gekkaihi⟧ - monthly fee
- {入会費|にゅうかいひ} - entrance/registration fee
- {会費制|かいひせい} - fixed-fee system
- {会費|かいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ - to collect fees
- {会費|かいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ - to pay fees

CULTURAL NOTE:
{会費制|かいひせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧ (fixed-fee weddings) are an alternative to traditional Japanese weddings where guests give monetary gifts (⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→ご祝儀：08356_goshuugi⟧). Each guest pays a set amount to cover their portion.
